The framework consists of three stages: Firstly, an LLM examiner agent is tasked with generating questions, mimicking real-life users posting queries. Secondly, two LLM candidates interact with each other and engage in a multi-round peer battle by answering the seed question individually, criticizing the opponent's weaknesses, and raising targeted follow-up queries to challenge the opponent further.
outputs: Responses generated during multi-round peer battles, including answers, criticisms, and follow-up questions.
generated questions, multi-turn peer battle responses, committee judgments
